note: A BLOCKING delegation: the Delegated entry names the requesting stage, the re-spawned Executor continues under (cont.), and an ordinary PASS ends with the line the archive command appends.

cites.text: If the requesting stage said it needs the results to finish (marked `BLOCKING`), re-spawn that stage. The stage then appends a `(cont.)` entry covering only the remainder of its work (Hard rules)
The orchestrating session appends your results to the log under `## Delegated — <requesting stage>`.
It appends `Archive target: <path>` as the last line of your entry

resume.next: hand back to the user: the PM's archive or clear did not finish
